## Overall assessment:

Like with the Appendix A material on Vector Spaces, the last time I did any problems like this was during college (6-9 years ago depending on the class), so I am not initially confident in my ability to solve any of the problems. However, with some practice and refreshers, I believe I could relearn the concepts in due time. Many of the words and concepts are familiar in words, but not so much in application and thorough understanding.
